storyTemplate.title: Sandbox Adventure Story
storyTemplate.description: A treasure-hunt adventure start: reach an expedition camp and join the search before the trail goes cold.

messages.speaker: Narrator
messages.text:
Canvas tents snap in the dry wind at the edge of Copper Mesa.

Pack animals stamp near the supply ropes, maps are pinned under stones, and half the camp is already arguing about which canyon hides the old road. The trail party leaves at dawn.

If you want in, you need a role in the expedition before the quartermaster closes the roster.
